info.title: Recoup Chat API
info.description: API documentation for the Recoup platform - an AI agent platform for the music industry

get.description: Retrieve chat rooms (conversations) for the authenticated account. If the account has access to organizations, pass account_id to filter to a specific account within those organizations. Optionally filter by an artist_account_id. The endpoint returns metadata about each room, including the topic, associated artist, and last updated timestamp.

parameters.name: artist_account_id
parameters.description: Optional. Filter chats to only include those for the specified artist.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: Filter to a specific account. Only applicable when the authenticated account has access to multiple accounts via organization membership.

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

403.description: Forbidden - account_id is not a member of the organization or account tried to filter by an account_id they don't have access to

post.description: Create a new chat room. Optionally associate it with an artist and/or provide a client-generated chat ID. Pass accountId to create a chat on behalf of a specific account the API key has access to.

400.description: Bad request - failed to create chat

403.description: Forbidden - API key does not have access to the specified accountId

patch.description: Update a chat room's topic (display name). The chatId is required; the topic field will be updated. Topic must be between 3 and 50 characters.

400.description: Bad request - invalid parameters or validation error

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

403.description: Forbidden - API key does not have access to this chat

404.description: Not found - chat room does not exist

delete.description: Delete a chat room by ID. This operation also removes related room records (memory emails, memories, room-report links, and segment-room links) before deleting the room itself.

400.description: Bad request - invalid parameters or validation error

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

403.description: Forbidden - API key does not have access to this chat

404.description: Not found - chat room does not exist

500.description: Server error - failed to delete chat

get.description: Retrieve the artist associated with a specific chat room. Returns 404 if the chat does not exist or is not accessible by the authenticated caller.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the chat room.

404.description: Not found - chat does not exist or is not accessible

get.description: Retrieve the segment associated with a specific chat room. Returns 404 if the chat does not exist or is not accessible by the authenticated caller.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the chat room.

404.description: Not found - chat does not exist or is not accessible

get.description: Retrieve all messages (memories) for a specific chat room in chronological order.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the chat room.

403.description: Forbidden - caller does not have access to this chat

404.description: Not found - chat does not exist or is not accessible

500.description: Server error - failed to retrieve messages

post.description: Copy all messages from the source chat (`id` path param) to a target chat (`targetChatId` in request body). By default, existing target messages are cleared before copy.

400.description: Bad request - invalid payload or chat identifiers

403.description: Forbidden - caller lacks access to source or target chat

404.description: Not found - source or target chat does not exist

500.description: Server error - failed to copy messages

delete.description: Delete all messages in a chat from a given message onward (inclusive), identified by `from_message_id`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the chat room.

parameters.name: from_message_id
parameters.description: The message UUID from which trailing messages should be deleted (inclusive).

400.description: Bad request - invalid or missing query/path parameters or message does not belong to chat

403.description: Forbidden - access denied to this chat

404.description: Not found - chat or message does not exist

500.description: Server error - failed to delete trailing messages

post.description: Generate AI-powered text responses using the Recoup chat system. This endpoint processes chat requests and returns generated text along with metadata about the generation process.

Stream AI-powered chat responses using the Recoup chat system. This endpoint mirrors the request payload of the Chat Generate API but returns a streaming response compatible with the Vercel AI SDK `createUIMessageStreamResponse`. The stream emits UI message parts encoded as data chunks that can be parsed with `createUIMessageStreamParser`.

200.description: Streaming response with UI message parts. Events include: message-start (assistant begins message), message-delta (incremental updates), message-end (assistant finishes message), error (stream error), and metadata (usage data).

schema.description: Server-Sent Events stream containing UI message parts

post.description: Compact one or more chat conversations into summarized versions. This reduces the size of chat history while preserving key information. Optionally provide a prompt to control what information gets preserved in the compacted summary.

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

404.description: Not found - one or more chat IDs do not exist

message.description: Error message describing what went wrong

ChatGenerateRequest.description: Request body for chat generation. Exactly one of 'prompt' or 'messages' must be provided.

prompt.description: Single text prompt for the assistant. Required if 'messages' is not provided.

messages.description: Array of UIMessage objects for context. Required if 'prompt' is not provided.

artistId.description: The unique identifier of the artist (optional)

model.description: The AI model to use for text generation (optional)

excludeTools.description: Array of tool names to exclude from execution

roomId.description: UUID of the chat room. If not provided, one will be generated automatically.

topic.description: Topic name for the new chat room (e.g., 'Pulse Feb 2'). Only applies when creating a new room - ignored if room already exists. To edit the topic of an existing room, use [PATCH /api/chats](/api-reference/chat/update).
